_why: F04 (named fights, code-blind judge): a tree's only collider is its trunk cylinder (vegetation.gd::_make_collision_shape), so the fight camera's arm and clear-orbit sweep saw straight through canopies and parked the lens inside them (Captain Oreth's grove: 14 of 24 probed bearings). Each resident trunk of a layer listed here also carries one box over its canopy -- the model's render bounds above the trunk collider, inset by `inset` -- on the camera rig's occlusion-only layer (mask 0): it stops the lens and nothing else. Walking, scatter and harvest see only the trunk. Kept out of vegetation.json on purpose: that file is part of the scatter bake's config fingerprint, and a camera-only setting must not stale the bake. TUNABLE.
_why_lower_bark: Stormwood's shared TwistedTree models have visible lower bark outside their unchanged walking cylinder. A shared camera-only trimesh uses only the actual Bark_TwistedTree faces below the existing 4-model-unit canopy boundary, clipped without caps or hulls; placement yaw, scale and render sink match the visible mesh. Upper-canopy boxes remain limited to the original layers.
